query:
SELECT id, name, enrichmentStatus, apolloId, fitScore,
  CASE WHEN briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END as has_brief,
  CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END as has_sales
FROM companies 
WHERE searchId IN (1500002, 1500003) 
AND (salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' OR fitScore IS NULL OR enrichmentStatus != 'enriched')
ORDER BY enrichmentStatus, fitScore;
